target: Analysis Plan explicitly names footbridge Switch-versus-Pole and speedboat Accelerate-versus-Oar as the personal-force comparisons, separately from physical-contact comparisons with the standard dilemmas.
sample_roles: Table1 identifies mutually exclusive between-subject Conditions2 and3 with74 and86 participants; Table2 prints those two groups for each target comparison, giving analytic participant N160. Each participant received both footbridge and speedboat versions in counterbalanced order, so do not double the participant count across dilemmas or substitute standard-condition N90.
not_df_inference: Counts and design directly establish N. No N is inferred from the printed Welch df, and rounded df are not used to infer a pooled Student test.
